events.description: Ross Geller says Ross Geller does not know whether Marcel is testing Ross Geller or Marcel is just acting out.
Ross Geller says Marcel is testing Ross Geller.
Ross Geller says Marcel is acting out.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller's monkey Marcel is out of control.
Ross Geller says Marcel keeps erasing the messages on Ross Geller's answering machine, supposedly by accident.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green has accidentally erased messages on an answering machine before.
Ross Geller says that for three days in a row Marcel got to the newspaper before Ross Geller did.
Ross Geller says Marcel peed all over the crossword in the newspaper.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green has never peed on a crossword in the newspaper.
Chandler Bing tells Joey Tribbiani to look at Phoebe Buffay.
Chandler Bing tells Joey Tribbiani to tell Chandler Bing that Phoebe Buffay does not look exactly like Ursula Buffay.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani sees a difference between Phoebe Buffay and Ursula Buffay.
Chandler Bing says Phoebe Buffay and Ursula Buffay are twins.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani does not care that Phoebe Buffay and Ursula Buffay are twins.
Joey Tribbiani says Phoebe Buffay is just Phoebe Buffay.
Joey Tribbiani says Ursula Buffay is hot.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing and Joey Tribbiani talk to each other about things.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing and Joey Tribbiani should not talk to each other about things any more.
Joey Tribbiani asks Phoebe Buffay to guess whom Joey Tribbiani and Chandler Bing saw today.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani and Chandler Bing saw Ursula Buffay today.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay's hairdresser cuts Phoebe Buffay's hair.
Monica Geller tells everyone to look.
Monica Geller says the guessing game about whom Joey Tribbiani and Chandler Bing saw could be a really long game.
Chandler Bing says Ursula Buffay works at Rifts.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay knows that Ursula Buffay works at Rifts.
Chandler Bing says Ursula Buffay said that Phoebe Buffay and Ursula Buffay have not talked in years.
Phoebe Buffay asks whether Ursula Buffay is fat.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani was standing where Joey Tribbiani could see Ursula Buffay.
Phoebe Buffay asks where Joey Tribbiani was standing when Joey Tribbiani saw Ursula Buffay.
Rachel Green asks whether Phoebe Buffay and Ursula Buffay get along.
Phoebe Buffay says the issues between Phoebe Buffay and Ursula Buffay are mostly just dumb sister stuff.
Phoebe Buffay says everyone always thought of Ursula Buffay as the pretty one.
Phoebe Buffay says Ursula Buffay was the first one to start walking.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay also started walking later that same day.
Phoebe Buffay says that by the time Phoebe Buffay started walking later that day, Phoebe Buffay's parents reacted as if it was not a big deal.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller is sorry.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller has to go.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller has a Lamaze class to attend.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing has an Earth Science class.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing will catch Ross Geller in Gym class.
Rachel Green asks whether the Lamaze class is just going to be Ross Geller and Carol Willick.
Ross Geller says Susan Bunch is going to be at the Lamaze class too.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller, Carol Willick, and Susan Bunch will all attend the Lamaze class together as the whole parenting team.
Rachel Green asks whether attending the Lamaze class with Carol Willick and Susan Bunch is going to be weird for Ross Geller.
Ross Geller says the situation might have been weird at first but is not weird now.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller is pretty comfortable with the whole situation with Carol Willick and Susan Bunch.
Monica Geller says the jacket Ross Geller is wearing belongs to Monica Geller.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller knows the jacket belongs to Monica Geller.
